reviews.text:
Wore this twice, the first time it kind of flaked off? The second time it holds. Very dark color, nearly black but I don't mind ☺️
Good color payoff tho
reviews.zh:
用咗兩次，第一次有少少甩碎屑？第二次就 keep 到。顏色好深，接近黑色，不過我唔介意 ☺️
不過顯色度幾好。

reviews.text: I purchased two liners and like them both! I gravitate towards the lilybyred one more just because I like a thicker line. I think it’s easy to use and of good quality. I’d say it’s good for beginners but if you are a beginner I’d go for a brown instead of black :)
reviews.zh: 買咗兩支眼線筆，兩支都鍾意！自己會傾向揀 lilybyred 嗰支多啲，因為鍾意畫粗少少。覺得好用，質素唔錯。新手都啱用，不過如果係新手嘅話我會建議揀啡色而唔係黑色 :)

reviews.text: The goods were shipped correctly, the contents are accurate, they are not near expiration, and the delivery was fast. I recommend purchasing them.
reviews.zh: 貨物出貨正確，內容物冇錯，距離到期日仲有時間，送貨都幾快。推薦購買。

reviews.text:
I have finally found the solution for my oily eyelids! I’ve always struggled with smudged eyeliner that seems to disappear or migrate down my face within a few hours, but this formula is a total game-changer.
The application is incredibly smooth, gliding on without any tugging. What impressed me the most was the intense pigment; even when I applied it to my waterline, the color stayed bold and defined. I put it to the ultimate test and it lasted a full 12 hours without budging or fading.
reviews.zh:
終於搵到解決我油眼皮嘅方法！一直以來都好受眼線暈染困擾，幾個鐘內就會消失或者暈到落塊面，但呢支配方真係完全改變咗局面。
上色超順滑，滑過眼窩時完全唔使拉扯。最令我驚喜嘅係佢嘅顯色度極高；即使畫喺內眼線，顏色都 keep 到夠實夠 sharp。我特登做咗終極測試，足足 12 個鐘都冇移位冇甩色。

reviews.text: Очень классная подводка, бода ни на что не надеясь, но она приятно меня удивила! Грифель очень тонкий и нежный, цвет коричневый, наносится легко и быстро. Ранее брала от Kissme, не очень понравилось.
reviews.zh: 呢支眼線筆真係好正，本住冇乜期望買，但結果畀咗我一個驚喜！筆芯好幼細柔軟，啡色，上色輕鬆又快。之前用過 Kissme 嗰支，但就覺得麻麻哋。

reviews.text: Walnut Brown is a pretty lighter brown shade that lends itself well to soft warm makeup. The formula itself is great, it's lasted through many crying sessions and only really comes off when rubbed - though keep in mind I have dry skin. It's smooth and the tip is precise - I usually use it to tightline.
reviews.zh: 呢個 Walnut Brown 係幾靚嘅淺啡色，幾適合用嚟畫柔和嘅暖調妝。配方本身好正，試過喊咗好多次都 keep 到，只係要擦先會甩——不過留意我係乾性肌。上色順滑，筆尖夠精準——我通常用嚟填內眼線。

reviews.text:
ITS SO GOOD!!
I’ve been using one that claimed it won’t smudge, but it still did on my oily eyelids 😭 BUT this fr saved me, it’s so so so sharp, and no smudging throughout the day!! Definitely stays for 12 hours :) I loved the color as well, I got Matt brown and it’s the perfect dark brown that isn’t too brown, but dark enough to be bold! 
I think it’ll last LONGER if you put some light eyeshadow on top of the eyeliner if you have oily eyelids like me :) 
(Water proof rating is a 4 bc I haven’t completely been with water yet, but I’ve walked in the rain before and looked good as before ;))
reviews.zh:
超好用！！
我之前用開嗰隻聲稱唔會化開，但係喺我油眼皮上面都仲係化咗 😭 但呢支真係救我，支筆超超超利，成日都冇化開！！真係 keep 到12個鐘 :) 我都好鍾意個色，我買咗 Matt brown，係完美嘅深啡，唔會太啡但夠深夠搶眼！
如果好似我咁有油眼皮，喺眼線上面再掃一層薄薄嘅眼影應該可以 keep 得更耐 :) 
(防水評分4分，因為我仲未完全試過落水，不過之前行過雨都仲係 keep 得好好 ;))

reviews.text:
The eyeliner works amazing, although it is not smear proof (as in you rub with your hands after it dries up)
it has really small tip to draw a super thin line and the color last pretty long as long as you don''t touch your eyes.
reviews.zh: 呢支眼線筆好好用，雖然唔係防抆（乾咗之後用手指捽會黐到）個筆尖超幼，可以畫到超幼嘅線，隻色 keep 得幾耐，只要唔掂到眼就冇問題。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
